<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project>
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
    <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
    <artifactId>greed-common</artifactId>
    <name>DDS2 greed common lib</name>
    <version>318.4.115</version>
    <scm>
        <connection>
         	scm:git:https://bitbucket.site.dukascopy.com/scm/jforex/data-common.git
        </connection>
    </scm>
    <contributors>
        <contributor>
            <name>Kostja Dorodoff</name>
        </contributor>
        <contributor>
            <name>Denis Larka</name>
        </contributor>
        <contributor>
            <name>Dmitry Shohov</name>
        </contributor>
        <contributor>
            <name>Martins Ceske</name>
        </contributor>
    </contributors>
    <distributionManagement>
        <repository>
			<id>dukascopy</id>
			<name>Dukascopy releases</name>
			<url>https://artifactory.site.dukascopy.com/artifactory/dukascopy</url>
		</repository>
		<snapshotRepository>
            <id>dukascopy</id>
            <name>Dukascopy snapshots</name>
            <url>https://artifactory.site.dukascopy.com/artifactory/dukascopy-snapshots</url>
		</snapshotRepository>
    </distributionManagement>
    <build>
        <sourceDirectory>src</sourceDirectory>
        <testSourceDirectory>test</testSourceDirectory>
        <testResources>
            <testResource>
                <directory>testresources</directory>
                <targetPath>.</targetPath>
            </testResource>
            <testResource>
                <directory>integrationtest</directory>
                <targetPath>integrationtest</targetPath>
            </testResource>
            <testResource>
                <directory>indicatortests</directory>
                <targetPath>indicatortests</targetPath>
            </testResource>
        </testResources>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.8.0</version>
                <inherited>true</inherited>
                <configuration>
                    <source>8</source>
                    <target>8</target>
                    <fork>true</fork>
                    <encoding>UTF-8</encoding>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                <artifactId>build-helper-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.12</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>add-test-source</id>
                        <phase>generate-test-sources</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>add-test-source</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <sources>
                                <source>test</source>
                                <source>integrationtest</source>
                            </sources>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-jar-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.0.2</version>
                <inherited>true</inherited>
                <configuration>
                    <archive>
                    	<index>true</index>
                        <manifest>
                            <addDefaultImplementationEntries>
                                true
                            </addDefaultImplementationEntries>
                        </manifest>
                        <manifestEntries>
							<Permissions>all-permissions</Permissions>
							<Codebase>*</Codebase>
							<Application-Name>${project.name}</Application-Name>
						</manifestEntries>
                    </archive>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <!-- this helps with mocked transport exceptions -->
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>2.20.1</version>
                <configuration>
                    <includes>
                        <include>**/*Test.java</include> <!-- filter unit tests to **/*Test.java -->
                    </includes>
                    <excludes>
                        <exclude>**/*$*</exclude> <!-- all inner classes -->
                    </excludes>
                    <forkMode>always</forkMode>
                    <parallel>classes</parallel>
                    <threadCount>10</threadCount>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>

        </plugins>
        <pluginManagement>
        	<plugins>
        		<!--This plugin's configuration is used to store Eclipse m2e settings only. It has no influence on the Maven build itself.-->
        		<plugin>
        			<groupId>org.eclipse.m2e</groupId>
        			<artifactId>lifecycle-mapping</artifactId>
        			<version>1.0.0</version>
        			<configuration>
        				<lifecycleMappingMetadata>
        					<pluginExecutions>
        						<pluginExecution>
        							<pluginExecutionFilter>
        								<groupId>
        									org.codehaus.mojo
        								</groupId>
        								<artifactId>
        									build-helper-maven-plugin
        								</artifactId>
        								<versionRange>
        									[1.12,)
        								</versionRange>
        								<goals>
        									<goal>add-test-source</goal>
        								</goals>
        							</pluginExecutionFilter>
        							<action>
        								<ignore></ignore>
        							</action>
        						</pluginExecution>
        					</pluginExecutions>
        				</lifecycleMappingMetadata>
        			</configuration>
        		</plugin>
        	</plugins>
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>

    <profiles>
        <profile>
            <id>integration-tests</id>
            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>2.20.1</version>
                        <configuration>
                            <includes>
                                <include>**/*IT.java</include> <!-- filter integration tests to **/*IT.java -->
                            </includes>
                            <excludes>
                                <exclude>**/*$*</exclude> <!-- all inner classes -->
                            </excludes>
                            <forkMode>always</forkMode>
                            <parallel>classes</parallel>
                            <threadCount>10</threadCount>
                        </configuration>
                    </plugin>
                </plugins>
            </build>
        </profile>
    </profiles>

    <dependencies>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>org.apache.commons</groupId>
			<artifactId>commons-lang3</artifactId>
			<version>3.3.2</version>
		</dependency>
        <dependency>
			<groupId>com.sun.jna</groupId>
			<artifactId>jna</artifactId>
			<version>3.5.0</version>
		</dependency>
        <dependency>
        	<groupId>com.dukascopy.api</groupId>
        	<artifactId>JForex-API</artifactId>
        	<version>2.13.98</version>
        	<optional>false</optional>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
            <artifactId>ui-core</artifactId>
            <version>1.6.102</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds4</groupId>
            <artifactId>netty-transport-client</artifactId>
            <version>1.2.26</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
  			<groupId>com.dukascopy</groupId>
  			<artifactId>auth-protocol-client</artifactId>
  			<version>1.2.2</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
            <artifactId>msg</artifactId>
            <version>1.1.98.2-JForex3</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.dukascopy.holiday</groupId>
            <artifactId>holiday-common</artifactId>
            <version>1.17</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>7zip</groupId>
            <artifactId>7zip</artifactId>
            <version>18.05</version>
        </dependency>
		<dependency>
    		<groupId>org.eclipse.jdt</groupId>
    		<artifactId>ecj</artifactId>
    		<version>3.20.0.1d</version>
		</dependency>
		<dependency>
    		<groupId>org.ow2.asm</groupId>
    		<artifactId>asm</artifactId>
    		<version>5.0.3</version>
		</dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>ta-lib</groupId>
            <artifactId>ta-lib</artifactId>
            <version>0.4.4dc</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
			<groupId>javax.mail</groupId>
			<artifactId>mail</artifactId>
			<version>1.4</version>
		</dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.fife</groupId>
            <artifactId>DDS2-TextEditor</artifactId>
            <version>1.27.98</version>
            <optional>true</optional>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>slf4j-log4j12</artifactId>
            <version>1.7.28</version>
            <!-- scope>test</scope -->
            <optional>true</optional>
        </dependency>
        <!-- dependency>
            <groupId>log4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>log4j</artifactId>
            <version>1.2.14</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency-->
        <dependency>
		    <groupId>com.googlecode.jmockit</groupId>
		    <artifactId>jmockit</artifactId>
		    <version>1.7</version>
		    <scope>test</scope>
		</dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>junit</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
            <version>4.12</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.easytesting</groupId>
            <artifactId>fest-assert-core</artifactId>
            <version>2.0M10</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

            <artifactId>lucene-core</artifactId>
            <version>3.4.0</version>
            <optional>true</optional>
        </dependency>
        
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.lucene</groupId>
            <artifactId>lucene-highlighter</artifactId>
            <version>3.4.0</version>

        <dependency>
    		<groupId>javax.jnlp</groupId>

    		<scope>system</scope>
            <optional>true</optional>
    		<systemPath>${java.home}/lib/javaws.jar</systemPath>
		</dependency>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>commons-beanutils</groupId>
			<artifactId>commons-beanutils</artifactId>
			<version>1.9.3</version>
		</dependency>
    </dependencies>    
</project>
